dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly concave trailing edge exhibiting a deep falcate curvature from the sub-apex to the base of the fin.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a moderate pixel radius and obtuse overall geometry.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The leading edge presents a convex slope at approximately 35 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible vertical linear rake marks appearing as faint light-grey striations on the lateral flank and the lower portion of the dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A minor notch or indentation is visible on the lower trailing edge near the point of attachment to the peduncle.
